nodes.title: Backend corrections
nodes.summary: Four fixes triaged from the subject-attribute-glossary-removal-backend review: one reachability bug against a decided rule, one removal residue, two pre-existing defects the review surfaced.

nodes.title: Accept an empty simulate subject at the wire so its 422 refusal is reachable
nodes.summary: simulate-case.dto.ts and simulate-hypothesis.dto.ts stop refusing an empty attributes array at the schema level, so buildSubject's own SubjectCarriesNoAttributeError (422) is what a caller actually receives.

nodes.title: Map DuplicateConceptAnswerError to its own status
nodes.summary: status-map.ts maps DuplicateConceptAnswerError to HTTP 500, instead of letting it fall through to the generic unmapped-error response.

nodes.title: Remove the leftover SubjectAttribute type alias
nodes.summary: terms.ts no longer exports a SubjectAttribute type, since no governed subject-attribute vocabulary exists any more.

nodes.title: Report the actual remaining deadline when persistence gives up
nodes.summary: run-diagnosis.ts's InvestigationWriteDeadlineExceededError now carries the milliseconds actually remaining of the declared deadline at the moment persistence gave up, not the bound persistence was granted at entry.
